text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the Spring Fan
Fest—a special event filled with events
and races to thank the
fans for their
continued support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is participating in this
year's
main event, the All-Stars Sandlot
Baseball
Tournament, as the team coach.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... The bases are all loaded. We're
still in the
lead, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The score stands at six to three. A home
run for
them now would be a total game
changer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What should we do, Coach? If we're
going to
make a move, wouldn't now be
the best time?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Next up is number four, right? Wow, it's
like something out of a comic! Knock it
outta the park! Get a home run for the

wiiin! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the bottom of the ninth, and the
team is in
trouble. But then, Seeking the
Pearl makes her
move...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, umpire! We're changing our
pitcher!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's my turn to stand on the mound!

text_block_list.name: Teammates
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Listen! I'm the coach,
so if our team is in
a pinch,
I'm the one who has to get us
out of it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't mean putting yourself in
the game!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it isn't against the rules,
but...
you
haven't done any warming up, have
you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't you worry about a thing.
The hasty
goddess of victories is giving
us a wink!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, if we have the goddess's seal of
approval,
then I suppose we can leave it
up to her, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Fine. Do your best, Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Pearl's stepping up to the mound?!

Whoa! Talk about a curveball!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Unfortunately for you, I'm up
next! Don't
forget I've batted
three-for-three homers today!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll set off the finale fireworks with my

Quebradora Con Giro killer swing!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is on the edge of their seats as
Seeking
the Pearl gets ready to throw
her first pitch!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's see if you can hit this excellent
ball
of mine!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: MUCHAS GRACIAAAS!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kachiiing!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Like a condor spreading its wings, the
ball takes
flight and soars into the air!
Looks like it's
heading for the stands!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeaaah! It's in the baaag! That's a
home—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's not over yet!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Seeking the Pearl has
thrown down
her glove and is making a
mad dash for the
stands!

text_block_list.name: Teammates and Fans
text_block_list.text: Wh-whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's reached the stands! But is the ball
too high
for her to catch?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Gooo, Peeearl!
Flyyy! Way to raise the
stakes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What'd they just say? "Fly all the
way to the
United States"?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. I'm Seeking the Pearl,
and I'm going
to fly all around the world! My
world-class talent is enough to bring me
even to America!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Not even a home run ball can escape my
reach!
Watch me spread my wings and
take flight! To the
air!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! She's climbing up the stands! Isn't
that
against the rules?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You're miiine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Waaah?! Pearl! What're you doing in the
stands?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Both Seeking the Pearl and the ball land
in the stands! What a comeback! El
Condor Pasa finishes
the game with a
walk-off grand slam!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Nooo! I flew the wrong way! I lost my
sense of
direction after I defied gravity!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
You went overboard! That's so
like you, though!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Today was so much fun!
We're going to
keep supporting you from here on
out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite losing the match, Seeking the
Pearl's
performance won't easily be
forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Caught it! Now to send it baaack!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! The ball's flying back to home
like a
firework rocket!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The runners can't make it back in time...
They're
ouuut! That's game!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We won! Pearl's jump was really
spectacular.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she actually flew... Hehe.
Nice
work.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I told you all, right? The goddess of
victory was
winking our way! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I've got goosebumps! I'm
seriously glad I
came!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Peaaarl! That was fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's no limit to how far I can fly!
Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl becomes an overnight
hero. Her dramatic victory will be
spoken of at Tracen
Academy for many
years to come... or something.
